crab-pots.name: Rose Cove Crab Pots
crab-pots.label: CRAB POTS
crab-pots.pitch: A LINE OF POTS ON THE COVE JETTY. PELL SAYS THE ROSEITE CRABS FETCH A GOOD PRICE IN SAPPHIRE, IF ANYONE BOTHERS TO HAUL THEM.

soda-cart.name: The Soda Cart
soda-cart.label: SODA CART
soda-cart.pitch: TWELVE FLAVOURS NOBODY CAN NAME. THE VENDOR'S SELLING UP TO CHASE A CAREER IN THE ARCADE.

vending-machine.name: The Vending Machine at the Edge of the Universe
vending-machine.label: VENDING MACHINE
vending-machine.pitch: IT HUMS. NO POWER CABLE. A STICKER ON THE SIDE: "FRANCHISE AVAILABLE. ENQUIRE WITHIN." THERE IS NO WITHIN.

upgrades.name: Restock with cans from a cycle that hasn't happened yet

skewer-cart.name: The Skewer Cart
skewer-cart.label: SKEWER CART
skewer-cart.pitch: THE OLD MAN WHO RUNS IT WANTS OUT. "BUY THE CART, KEEP THE GRILL HOT, TAKE THE NIGHT TRADE."

upgrades.name: A neon sign that says SKEWERS

spice-stall.name: Sapphire Spice Stall
spice-stall.label: SPICE STALL
spice-stall.pitch: SIX COLOURS OF SALT AND A SUGAR THAT GLOWS IN THE DARK. THE TRADER WANTS TO GO BACK TO SEA.

fish-stall.name: Sapphire Fish Stall
fish-stall.label: FISH STALL
fish-stall.pitch: THE STALL'S OWNER IS RETIRING TO THE ROSE BATHHOUSE. THE ICE, THE AWNING AND THE REGULARS COME WITH IT.

upgrades.name: Your own fishing boat at the pier

bathhouse.name: The Rose Bathhouse
bathhouse.label: BATHHOUSE
bathhouse.pitch: THE HARVESTERS RUN IT BETWEEN SHIFTS AND HATE IT. THEY'D SELL YOU THE LEASE IN A HEARTBEAT.

upgrades.name: Paper lanterns all the way down the path
A second pool, dug and lined

herb-stall.name: Mirelle's Glow Stall
herb-stall.pitch: "THE GLOW MARKET OPENS WHEN THE SUN GOES. I WOULD RATHER BE IN THE WOOD THAN BEHIND A TABLE OF MOONCAPS. TAKE THE STALL; FIND SOMEONE WHO KEEPS ELF HOURS."

upgrades.name: Moonwell water, sold by the vial

crusty-loaf.name: The Crusty Loaf
crusty-loaf.pitch: "I'LL BAKE TILL THEY CARRY ME OUT, LOVE, BUT THE BOOKS, THE COUNTER AND THE FLOUR BILLS? HAVE THEM. YOU'LL WANT SOMEONE ON THE COUNTER BY DAWN."

upgrades.name: Honey cakes by the crate to the Hayloft

pennyworths.name: Pennyworth's
pennyworths.pitch: "FORTY YEARS OF STRING, SEED AND SENSIBLE BOOTS. I'D SELL THE LEASE AND STAY ON AS THE NAME OVER THE DOOR. THE TILL'S YOURS TO MIND."

upgrades.name: Catalogue goods off the mail ship

ski-hire.name: Fellhaven Ski Hire
ski-hire.pitch: "I'D RATHER WAX THAN COUNT. BUY THE HIRE, I'LL KEEP THE SKIS SHARP. YOU'LL NEED A HAND ON THE COUNTER FROM FIRST LIFT TO LAST."

noodle-bar.name: Miyu's Noodles
noodle-bar.pitch: "I COOK. I DO NOT DO RENT, TAX OR THE NIGHT SHIFT. YOU BUY IN, YOU WORRY ABOUT THE COUNTER, I WORRY ABOUT THE BROTH. DEAL?"

upgrades.name: Six more stools at the counter
A delivery drone with a hot box

hayloft.name: The Hayloft
hayloft.pitch: "THE CIDER POURS ITSELF, THE FIDDLER DOESN'T. A PLACE LIKE THIS NEEDS A PROPER MANAGER, NOT A LAD ON A STOOL. FIND ONE AND IT'S YOURS."

terns-rest.name: The Tern's Rest
terns-rest.pitch: "ROOMS, STEW AND EVERY SAILOR ON THE TERN PASSAGE. IT'S TOO MUCH FOR ONE PAIR OF HANDS. BRING A MANAGER WHO CAN KEEP A LEDGER AND I'LL STICK TO THE POT."

upgrades.name: Four more rooms over the stable
Your own fishing smack for the stew

crown-anchor.name: The Crown & Anchor
crown-anchor.pitch: "BEST HOUSE IN CROWNHAVEN, AND I'M TIRED. THE FIGUREHEAD STAYS. THE REGULARS STAY. YOU PUT A MANAGER BEHIND THE BAR WHO CAN HANDLE A NAVY CREW ON PAY NIGHT."

upgrades.name: Music every night from the Exchange quartet

snowcap-lodge.name: The Snowcap Lodge
snowcap-lodge.pitch: "THE FIRE NEVER GOES OUT AND NEITHER DO I. TIME SOMEONE ELSE WATCHED THE NIGHT DESK. A MANAGER, MIND, NOT A SKI BUM."

upgrades.name: The summit hut, open for overnights

club-void.name: Club Void
club-void.pitch: "THE OWNER SKIPPED TOWN AND LEFT ME THE KEYS. I PLAY RECORDS, I DON'T DO DOORS, LICENCES OR BAR STOCK. YOU WANT IT, IT NEEDS A MANAGER WHO CAN SAY NO TO A CORP KID."

upgrades.name: A sound system that rattles teeth

holm-resort.name: The Starling
holm-resort.label: THE STARLING
holm-resort.pitch: YOUR OWN HOTEL ON YOUR OWN ISLAND. BUILD IT FROM THE HOLM'S LEDGER.

upgrades.name: A bathing jetty and changing huts
A packet boat from the capital, twice a day

royale-table.name: A Table at the Neon Royale
royale-table.pitch: "THE DUCHESS LEASES A TABLE CONCESSION NOW AND THEN. YOU RUN THE TABLE, YOU TAKE THE EDGE. YOU'LL WANT A FLOOR MANAGER, AND A DEALER WHO DOESN'T BLINK."

trading-house.name: A Trading House in Crownhaven
trading-house.pitch: "A SEAT ON THE EXCHANGE AND A HOUSE ON THE QUAY. CARGO IN, CARGO OUT, A CUT OF EVERYTHING. THE CHARTER REQUIRES A RESIDENT MANAGER; A GOOD BROKER PAYS THEIR OWN WAGE."

upgrades.name: A standing contract with the Crown

royal-yard.name: A Share in the Royal Yard
royal-yard.pitch: "THE CROWN WANTS A PARTNER IN THE YARD. BUY IN AND YOU TAKE A CUT OF EVERY HULL THAT LEAVES THE SLIP. PUT A YARD MANAGER IN, AND A MASTER WRIGHT IF YOU CAN FIND ONE."

high-roller.name: The High-Roller Room
high-roller.pitch: "EVERYTHING IN THIS ROOM IS FOR SALE, DARLING, INCLUDING THE ROOM. THE HOUSE EDGE ON EVERY WHALE THAT WALKS IN. TWO MILLION, AND A MANAGER I APPROVE OF."

upgrades.name: A private lift from the skywalk
